title: rosa × centifolia f. cristata
intro: Rosa × centifolia f. cristata, commonly known as the 'Cristata Rose', is a variety of rose that is characterized by its compact, bushy growth habit and clusters of fragrant, pink flowers. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, making it useful for wound healing and skin care. The therapeutic actions of Rosa × centifolia f. cristata include its ability to reduce inflammation, soothe digestive issues, and calm the nervous system. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic actions include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which have been shown to possess antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties.
